caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape and four short legs. The body of the chest is painted in a muted blue color. The front panel features three arched sections outlined in white, each containing a symmetrical floral arrangement in shades of red, orange, white, and green, set within an ornate basket. In the central arched section, there is a dark green plaque bordered in white with decorative text in a light color that reads "Maria Elizbetha Budin". The top edge and lid of the chest are a natural brown wood tone, contrasting with the painted body. The sides of the chest are decorated with a circular motif in a dark brown color, outlined and divided into segments, resembling a rosette pattern. The chest stands on sturdy, block-like feet, and the background of the drawing is a plain, light off-white color.
title: Pa. German Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
